digest.component_or_area: live external LLM testing / provider matrix guard
propositions: The provider guard at test_provider_matrix_live.py:88 rejects openai model specs because it compares the resolved qualifier 'openai-chat' literally against the declared provider family 'openai', yielding a false-positive assertion failure.

The live external tier lacks the qualifier-to-family mapping that the unit tier gained in commit 8f4c5fdb0d3, causing configured_provider() to return 'openai-chat' instead of 'openai' and credential_present() to fail its _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV lookup.
All llm_live tests on the openai arm are silently skipped because live_llm_ready() returns False when configured_provider() returns 'openai-chat' and the credential map has no matching entry.

The fix adds _PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER mapping and provider_family() helper to _live_llm.py so configured_provider() returns the family name, and updates the two guard comparisons in test_provider_matrix_live.py to compare families instead of literal qualifiers.
Unit regression tests are added to detect when the openai arm is not live-ready due to qualifier/family mismatch, caught before live runs.
The resolver's openai-chat canonicalization remains the authoritative contract; no src/ code changes are required.
